tools.name: hae_list_projects
tools.description: List all projects the current user has access to, including their columns. Does NOT include cards — an empty-looking column here is not proof a project has no cards, call hae_list_cards per column_id to check

tools.name: hae_get_project
tools.description: Get a project by ID — includes columns and members, but NOT cards or card counts. To see if a project actually has content, call hae_list_cards for each column_id returned here — do not conclude a project is empty from this tool alone

tools.name: hae_create_project
tools.description: Create a new project

tools.name: hae_update_project
tools.description: Update a project name or description

tools.name: hae_delete_project
tools.description: Delete a project permanently (DESTRUCTIVE — cannot be undone)

tools.name: hae_assign_project_org
tools.description: Assign a project to an organisation

tools.name: hae_add_project_member
tools.description: Add a user to a project by user ID

tools.name: hae_update_project_member
tools.description: Change a project member's role

tools.name: hae_remove_project_member
tools.description: Remove a member from a project

tools.name: hae_create_column
tools.description: Create a custom column in a project

tools.name: hae_update_column
tools.description: Rename a column

tools.name: hae_delete_column
tools.description: Delete a column (cards are moved to Trash)

tools.name: hae_list_cards
tools.description: List all cards in a column — includes checklist progress and comment count

tools.name: hae_get_card
tools.description: Get full card details: description, labels, members, checklists, stopwatch

tools.name: hae_create_card
tools.description: Create a new card at the bottom of a column

due_date.description: Due date as Unix timestamp in ms

tools.name: hae_quick_capture_card
tools.description: Create a card directly in a project's Inbox column, without needing a column ID — the fastest way to jot something down

tools.name: hae_update_card
tools.description: Update a card: title, description, due date, or move to another column

due_date.description: New due date (Unix ms), null to clear

column_id.description: Target column ID to move the card

tools.name: hae_duplicate_card
tools.description: Duplicate a card (copies title, description and due date)

tools.name: hae_delete_card
tools.description: Delete a card — moves to Trash by default, or hard-delete if permanent=true (DESTRUCTIVE if permanent)

permanent.description: true = hard delete immediately. Default: false (trash)

tools.name: hae_get_card_activities
tools.description: Get the activity log of a card (moves, edits, comments, etc.)

tools.name: hae_stopwatch_start
tools.description: Start the stopwatch on a card

tools.name: hae_stopwatch_stop
tools.description: Stop the stopwatch on a card

tools.description: Unassign a user from a card

tools.description: Add a label to a card

tools.description: Remove a label from a card

tools.name: hae_subscribe_card
tools.description: Subscribe to notifications for a card

tools.name: hae_unsubscribe_card
tools.description: Unsubscribe from notifications for a card

tools.description: List all comments on a card, ordered by date

tools.name: hae_add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a card

tools.name: hae_update_comment
tools.description: Edit a comment

tools.description: Delete a comment

tools.description: Update an organisation name or description
